result.title: AnchorRM: Parallel Intra-Batch State Reconstruction with Anchor-Based Residual Memory for Temporal Graph Neural Networks
result.summary: Memory-based temporal graph neural networks (TGN) rely on recurrent node memories to capture evolving interaction histories. However, temporal mini-batching introduces a trade-off between computational efficiency and temporal fidelity: when a node appears multiple times within the same batch, later interactions are evaluated using stale pre-batch memory because the intermediate memory updates have not yet been committed. This problem becomes more severe as temporal batch size increases. To overcome this challenge, we propose AnchorRM, an anchor-based residual memory mechanism that reconstructs event-specific intra-batch node states without executing sequential recurrent updates. AnchorRM treats the last committed node memory at the beginning of each batch as a pre-batch fixed anchor and uses causally preceding same-batch interactions to infer the missing state evolution relative to that anchor. The learned residual then calibrates the anchor to reconstruct an event-specific node memory for each interaction. Because each event-specific residual is predicted directly from the fixed anchor and its causal history, reconstructed states do not depend on previously reconstructed states and can therefore be computed in parallel within the batch while preserving temporal causality. Experiments across four temporal graph datasets and three memory-based backbones demonstrate that AnchorRM achieves an average 6.16x training speedup (up to 10.05x) and 28.67x batch scaling (up to 40x). These results demonstrate that AnchorRM substantially improves the scalability and training efficiency of memory-based temporal graph learning while maintaining competitive predictive performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AnchorRM，用于基于记忆的时序图神经网络：以批开始前最后提交的节点记忆为固定锚点，从因果上在先的同批交互中学习残差，直接预测每个交互的事件特异节点状态，从而在不执行串行循环更新的前提下并行重建批内状态。在四个时序图数据集、三种记忆骨干上报告约 6.16 倍训练加速与更好的批扩展性，预测性能保持可比。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉多模态推理主线无直接关系，但「固定锚点＋学习残差、重建状态不依赖其他重建状态却仍需保持因果顺序」这一做法，可能为 LVR 中多步 latent 状态的并行更新、陈旧状态校准与因果约束提供可供核查的方法线索。
